data.name: PageIntro
data.value: Consent form for minor young service providers who wish to take on missions through the platform.

data.name: LegalDisclaimer
data.value: Working draft — to be reviewed by legal counsel before any publication. The text below can be replaced without changing the technical architecture.

data.name: NonJeune_Titre
data.value: Access reserved for invited young providers

data.name: NonJeune_Message
data.value: This page is for young service providers invited by a coach. If you believe you should have access, ask your coach to send you an invitation.

data.name: ConsentementNonRequis_Message
data.value: Parental consent does not apply to your profile — you are an adult. You can continue with the self-observation questionnaire and your missions.

data.name: InviterJeune_Intro
data.value: Invite a young person by email. They will create their account via the link received. Parental consent applies only to minors.

data.name: InviterJeune_FormDesc
data.value: Check the email and date of birth before sending.

data.name: InviterJeune_SuccesEmail
data.value: An invitation email was sent to {0}.

data.name: InviterJeune_SuccesLien
data.value: Invitation created. The email could not be sent automatically — share the link below with the young person.

data.name: InviterJeune_LienHint
data.value: Copy this link and send it to the young person.

data.name: Erreur_NomPrenomRequis
data.value: The young person's last name and first name(s) are required.

data.name: Erreur_InvitationEchec
data.value: The invitation could not be created.

data.name: Section1_Intro
data.value: Information from your young provider profile (read-only).

data.name: Section2_Intro
data.value: Legal representative 1 is required. A second representative may be added if needed.

data.name: Section3_Description
data.value: We authorize our child to register on the platform and accept age-appropriate missions, under our supervision and in accordance with the young providers' charter.

data.name: AutorisationMissions_Label
data.value: I authorize my child to take on missions through the platform

data.name: Section4_Description
data.value: We authorize income from missions and agree on the following split between extracurricular activities and pocket money.

data.name: AutorisationRevenus_Label
data.value: I authorize income collection and distribution

data.name: Section5_Description
data.value: We authorize processing of the young person's personal data and, where applicable, use of their image strictly within missions and program-related communication.

data.name: AutorisationDonneesEtImage_Label
data.value: I authorize data processing and image use in this context

data.name: Section6_Intro
data.value: By confirming this consent, we commit to:

data.name: EngagementScolariteSanteEquilibre
data.value: Ensure missions do not harm our child's schooling, health, or life balance

data.name: EngagementInformerContraintes
data.value: Inform the platform and coach of any constraints (schedule, transport, health, etc.)

data.name: EngagementEncouragerCharte
data.value: Encourage our child to follow the young providers' charter

data.name: EngagementSignalerMissionInadaptee
data.value: Promptly report any mission that seems unsuitable for our child's age or situation

data.name: EngagementCollaborerCoach
data.value: Collaborate with the assigned coach when applicable

data.name: Section7_Intro
data.value: By typing our names below, we confirm we have read this form and give our consent. This is a typed confirmation, not a qualified electronic signature under eIDAS.

data.name: NomParent2Confirmation
data.value: Legal representative 2 full name (confirmation, if provided)

data.name: ErreurChampsManquants
data.value: The following must be completed before confirmation:

data.name: GrilleObs_Intro
data.value: Periodic assessment of socio-professional skills — history preserved across missions.

data.name: GrilleObs_CommentaireGeneralHint
data.value: Coaching notes for coaches only — never visible to the young person.

data.name: GrilleObs_CommentaireCritere
data.value: Comment (optional, visible to the young person)

data.name: GrilleObs_AccesRefuse_Message
data.value: This grid is reserved for invited young service providers and their assigned coach.

data.name: GrilleObs_SelectionnerEvaluation
data.value: Select an evaluation from the history or create a new one.

data.name: GrilleObs_Def_ponctualite
data.value: Arrives on time for appointments, missions, and scheduled activities.

data.name: GrilleObs_Def_comprehension_consignes
data.value: Understands and applies instructions; asks for clarification when needed.

data.name: GrilleObs_Def_autonomie
data.value: Works and acts independently without constant supervision.

data.name: GrilleObs_Def_communication
data.value: Expresses clearly orally and in writing; listens to others.

data.name: GrilleObs_Def_soin_travail
data.value: Completes tasks with attention, precision, and quality.

data.name: GrilleObs_Def_respect_cadre
data.value: Respects rules, schedules, and constraints of the professional environment.

data.name: GrilleObs_Def_proprete
data.value: Maintains cleanliness of workspace and equipment.

data.name: GrilleObs_Def_presentation_vestimentaire
data.value: Adopts appropriate, neat attire for the professional context.

data.name: GrilleObs_Def_presentation_verbale
data.value: Uses appropriate, courteous, and professional language.

data.name: GrilleObs_Def_sens_responsabilite
data.value: Takes ownership of commitments and consequences of actions.

data.name: GrilleObs_Def_sens_engagement
data.value: Invests in missions and sees them through to completion.

data.name: GrilleObs_Def_initiative
data.value: Takes relevant initiative without waiting to be asked.

data.name: GrilleObs_Def_creativite
data.value: Proposes new ideas and original solutions.

data.name: GrilleObs_Def_debrouillardise
data.value: Finds solutions when facing setbacks and difficulties.

data.name: GrilleObs_Def_respect
data.value: Treats colleagues, clients, and interlocutors with consideration.

data.name: GrilleObs_Def_honnetete
data.value: Tells the truth and acts transparently.

data.name: GrilleObs_Def_integrite
data.value: Acts in line with ethical values and established rules.

data.name: GrilleObs_Def_perfectionnisme
data.value: Strives for excellence without unnecessarily blocking progress.

data.name: GrilleObs_Def_discretion
data.value: Preserves confidentiality of information in their possession.

data.name: GuideEntrevue_Intro
data.value: Confidential preparation and notes space to structure the first interview and the ones that follow. Never visible to the young person.

data.name: GuideEntrevue_AccesRefuse_Message
data.value: This interview guide is reserved for the coach who follows this young person.

data.name: GuideEntrevue_MissionsAdaptees
data.value: Types of missions suited to their level

data.name: GuideEntrevue_Questions_Intro
data.value: Reference text to use during the interview — not editable.

data.name: GuideEntrevue_Peurs_Intro
data.value: Document content is read-only; record your observations in the “Coach note” column.

data.name: GuideEntrevue_Col_Phrase
data.value: What the young person might say

data.name: GuideEntrevue_Q_q1
data.value: What makes you think you wouldn't be able to complete this mission?

data.name: GuideEntrevue_Q_q2
data.value: What is the worst that could happen if you made a mistake?

data.name: GuideEntrevue_Q_q3
data.value: Are you afraid of doing it wrong, of not understanding, or of not daring to ask?

data.name: GuideEntrevue_Q_q4
data.value: Are you afraid of being judged by the client, by the coach, or by someone else?

data.name: GuideEntrevue_Q_q5
data.value: At what point do you think you might feel lost?

data.name: GuideEntrevue_Q_q6
data.value: Is it easy for you to say you don't understand or to ask for help?

data.name: GuideEntrevue_Q_q7
data.value: Have you ever been in a situation where you felt set up to fail?

data.name: GuideEntrevue_Q_q8
data.value: What would be different this time with the coach's support?

data.name: GuideEntrevue_Q_q9
data.value: What would reassure you before starting?

data.name: GuideEntrevue_Peur_peur_incapacite_Phrase
data.value: I don't know if I'll make it

data.name: GuideEntrevue_Peur_peur_incapacite_Question
data.value: What makes you doubt? Have you already succeeded at something similar?

data.name: GuideEntrevue_Peur_peur_incapacite_Levier
data.value: Start with a simple, well-framed mission

data.name: GuideEntrevue_Peur_peur_erreur_Phrase
data.value: What if I do it wrong?

data.name: GuideEntrevue_Peur_peur_erreur_Question
data.value: What could we plan for if you don't understand or if you make a mistake?

data.name: GuideEntrevue_Peur_peur_erreur_Levier
data.value: Plan a right to make mistakes and a contact channel with the coach

data.name: GuideEntrevue_Peur_peur_deranger_Peur
data.value: Fear of bothering or seeming weak

data.name: GuideEntrevue_Peur_peur_deranger_Question
data.value: How could you simply ask for a clarification?

data.name: GuideEntrevue_Peur_peur_deranger_Levier
data.value: Prepare a sample phrase for asking for help

data.name: GuideEntrevue_Peur_peur_jugement_Peur
data.value: Fear of how others see them

data.name: GuideEntrevue_Peur_peur_jugement_Question
data.value: What do you imagine the other person might think? Is that a fact or an assumption?

data.name: GuideEntrevue_Peur_peur_jugement_Levier
data.value: Clarify the supportive framework and the learning role of the mission

data.name: GuideEntrevue_Peur_peur_experience_passee_Peur
data.value: Fear linked to a past experience

data.name: GuideEntrevue_Peur_peur_experience_passee_Question
data.value: What had happened? What could be different this time?

data.name: GuideEntrevue_Peur_peur_experience_passee_Levier
data.value: Identify conditions that make the new experience safer

data.name: GuideEntrevue_Posture
data.value: The coach can adopt a three-step posture: welcome the fear without minimizing it, make it more precise, then build a first safe action. For example: “It's normal to feel apprehensive when starting something new. When you say you're not sure of yourself, is it more the fear of doing it wrong, of not understanding, or of how others see you? What small first step would let you try without feeling put at risk?”
